page.layout: One printed page, title page. Top: title block in large capitals and italic lines, centred. Below: a woodcut engraving in the centre. Below the woodcut: imprint lines and date, centred.

l.i: Revera mihi videtur esse ars artium, & disciplina disciplinarum, hominem regere, qui certe est inter omnes animantes maxime & moribus varius, & voluntate diversus.

page.notes: The engraving is a woodcut oval with a figure (a standing man with a tree and a bird) and the letters OMNIA and VANITAS-style inscriptions around the frame; it is not transcribed. Title lines are reproduced as printed; the small decorative capitals (J, S, E, C) are large initials. The date reads MDCVIII.
